messages:
claire: tossing an idea into the ring: add a lightweight fingerprint + smoke-delta step after intake that answers: did this artifact materially change behavior vs the last accepted version? target runtime: <4m.

oscar: +1. what would the fingerprint include? tokenizer hash, model-arch-signature, topK-signature on anchors, and a compact perf vector?

claire: exactly. fingerprint = {tokenizer_hash, param-count-bucket, kv-signature, top5-signature-per-anchor}. store it in registry. on new intake compute delta against golden fingerprint.

ty: for smoke-delta, we should compute a small metric set: top1-change(pct), top5-jaccard, tokenization-diff-count, p95_ratio. then map to policy: if any hard delta -> quarantine; if soft delta -> probation+canary.

mei: who decides thresholds? we need defensive defaults but allow product to tighten per org. propose default hard thresholds: tokenizer_diff>0 OR top1_drop>8% -> hard; soft: top1_drop 3-8% or p95_ratio>1.15 -> probation.

oscar: how to handle nondet? use seeded anchors and topK-index hashing to avoid float variance. also compare position-aware counts, not raw logits.

claire: runtime: two-phase. sync fingerprint+tokenizer parity (<30s) then async smoke-delta (2-4m). sync returns header X-Admit-Decision: PENDING|FAST_FAIL|FAST_PASS and an admit_run_id. async resolves to DECISION_ALLOW/PROBATION/QUARANTINE.

ty: audit + offline: for private deployments, support signed-fingerprint blobs so offline validators can attest to a run. schema: run_id, fingerprint_digest, decision, runner_digest, signature. registry verifies signature when uploaded.

mei: cost accounting: tag each run with cost_units (gpu_secs) and org_id so we can bill and enforce quotas. if org quota exhausted, smoke-delta should return PROBATION with reason "quota_exhausted" and schedule background deep-bench when quota freed.

oscar: nice. UX: console card should say "Delta summary: top1 -2.3%, top5_jaccard 0.96, p95 +8%" and a small link "see anchor diffs". also a one-click "rerun delta locally" that copies: `./smoke-delta --artifact 0x123 --seed 9 --anchors all`.

claire: telemetry: emit admit_run_id, fingerprint_digest, seed, runner_image, gpu_type, and a compact diff blob (gzipped) with top token changes. keep payload small.

ty: alerting flow: if PROBATION -> create temporary flag in registry and route 0.1% traffic for 48h. if during canary we observe user-facing regressions (via quality monitors) -> escalate to QUARANTINE. attach run ids to alerts.

mei: compatibility checks: apart from fingerprints, run a tiny compatibility matrix: ONNX/torchscript export sanity + KV persistence smoke. if export fails -> hard-fail. include export logs in the report.

oscar: adapter pruning note: when we remove legacy adapters, make sure our fingerprinting binary can accept older artifact layouts. add a compatibility layer that extracts tokens from old tar layouts for 30d.

infra-bot: infra: smoke-delta image pushed gcr.io/redwood/smoke-delta:v1.0 sha256:ff12be. admitted-run queue configured with rate 100/min per region.

claire: data retention: keep fingerprint history for 90 days for drift analysis. allow product to extend for enterprise contracts. weekly job should compute drift trends and tag models with "drift_score".

ty: edge-case: huge models where anchor generation is costly. allow a "micro-anchor" mode with single short anchor and stricter thresholds as fallback. mark these runs as lower-confidence.

mei: governance: I'll draft a short policy doc: thresholds, TTLs, billing impact, and private-run attestation protocol. will include examples of drift triggers and playbook.

oscar: I'll add a unit for the topK-signature lib and test nondet across GPUs. plus an integration test for fingerprinting across format variants.

claire: great. I'll create the RFC PR describing the fingerprint schema, smoke-delta metrics, and the admit state-machine. tagging @oscar @ty @mei for review. :sparkles:

oscar: small ask: add a field `previous_accepted_artifact` in the async result so reviewers can quickly compare.

claire: yes will include that. thanks all!
